newsitem.title: CHINA: CHINA INTERBANK MARKET RATES (CHIBOR) MOSTLY UP.
newsitem.headline: CHINA INTERBANK MARKET RATES (CHIBOR) MOSTLY UP.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Friday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
Turnover rose to 1.719 billion yuan from 1.061 billion yuan with the 30-day contract the most actively traded.

Traders said trading was more active than Thursday mainly due to the strong performance of the domestic A share market in the past two days, which made securities brokerages borrow more money on the interbank market.

But state banks and short-term financial centres, money brokerages run by the central bank, traded little due in part to renewed rumours that the central bank would cut bank reserve ratios soon, traders said.
A Hong Kong newspaper said on Friday the central bank had decided a cut in the ratios before October.
Traders said they expected the rates to move narrowly in slow trading next week.
